fact: The consolidated text of the Cybercrimes Act (Cap. 443, Revised Edition 2023, originally Act No. 14 of 2015) states it commenced on 1 September 2015 under GN No. 528 of 2015 and applies to Mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar, criminalising illegal access, interception, data interference, fraud and forgery.

The ICT Minister said on 19 August 2026 that section 29 of the Cybercrimes Act provides a fine of not less than 100m/- or three times the damage, imprisonment of at least five years, or both, for damaging critical ICT infrastructure.
